metadata.explanation: Task requires splitting employee data, identifying C-level executives, and highlighting their rows. Verified with Python: C-level executives are in rows 3 (CEO), 5 (CFO), and 12 (CTO). Instruction mentions 'yellow' (color name, not hex code), so evaluator uses fuzzy color matching with tolerance.
